title: Mikaela Shiffrin reflects on winning gold again and grief after the loss of her father
summary: Mikaela Shiffrin says her third Olympic gold medal "does feel different." The U.S. skiing star broke her medal drought at the Winter Games in Italy, taking home the gold in the women's slalom. She reflected on her Olympic journey, challenges she's faced and grieving after the loss of her father in 2020.
